title: Ring of Hollow Blood
summary: Ha-Jun approaches the obsidian pedestal to claim the Ring of Hollow Blood. An ancient demonic blood ward challenges his lineage, forcing him to offer his blood to shatter the seal and bind the Relic.

panels.shot: wide shot ha-jun walking toward pedestal
panels.action: Ha-Jun's footsteps echo softly on the cracked marble mosaic floor as he approaches the glowing pedestal.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's footsteps echo softly on the cracked marble mosaic floor as he approaches the glowing pedestal.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke nakshekadam toote hue sangmarmar ke mozek farsh par dhire-dhire goonjte hain kyonki wah chamakte hue aasan ke paas pahunchta hai.

panels.shot: crimson light washing over ha-jun face
panels.action: The pulsing ruby glow paints sharp blood-red highlights across Ha-Jun's pale cheeks and dark eyes.
panels.prose_en: The pulsing ruby glow paints sharp blood-red highlights across Ha-Jun's pale cheeks and dark eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Spandit ruby chamak Ha-Jun ke peele gaalon aur gahri aankhon par tej khoon-lal highlights ko chitrit karti hai.

panels.action: Kuro taps the reinforced spellbound glass with a sharp obsidian claw.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Blood Seal of Agony. Sirf wahi ise chhu sakta hai jiske ragon mein Sovereign ka khoon behta ho.

panels.prose_en: Kuro taps the reinforced spellbound glass with a sharp obsidian claw.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ek tej obsidian panje ke saath prabalit mantramugdh glass ko tap karta hai.

panels.action: Carved in archaic demonic cuneiform runes: 'Blood demands blood. The vessel must bleed to rule.'
panels.prose_en: Carved in archaic demonic cuneiform runes: 'Blood demands blood. The vessel must bleed to rule.'.
panels.prose_hi: Puratan shaitani demonic cuniform runs mein ukera gaya: 'khun khoon mangta hai. shasan karne ke liye jahaj ko khoon bahana hoga.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun stares at his open right palm, remembering how his blood awakened Kuro's feather on the rooftop.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar mere bhai ne yeh sahe tha... toh main peeche nahi hatunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stares at his open right palm, remembering how his blood awakened Kuro's feather on the rooftop.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni khuli dahini hatheli ko dekhta hai aur yaad karta hai ki kaise uske khoon ne chhat par Kuro ke pankh ko jaga diya tha.

panels.shot: ha-jun cutting thumb on glass rim
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses his thumb firmly against the razor-sharp edge of the cracked reliquary glass.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun presses his thumb firmly against the razor-sharp edge of the cracked reliquary glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne anguthe ko toote hue avashesh kaanch ke ustra-nukile kinare par majbuti se dabata hai.

panels.shot: crimson droplet falling in slow motion
panels.action: A single sphere of dark scarlet blood falls in dramatic slow-motion toward the glowing red gem.
panels.prose_en: A single sphere of dark scarlet blood falls in dramatic slow-motion toward the glowing red gem.
panels.prose_hi: Gahre lal rang ke khoon ka ek gola natakiya roop se dhimi gati se chamakte lal ratna ki or girta hai.

panels.action: The droplet splashes against the liquid ruby center of the ring, causing an immediate blinding crimson flare.
panels.prose_en: The droplet splashes against the liquid ruby center of the ring, causing an immediate blinding crimson flare.
panels.prose_hi: Boond ring ke taral ruby kendra par chhinte maarti hai, jisse turant andhi lal rang ki chamak paida ho jaati hai.

panels.action: The ancient spellbound glass dome violently implodes outward into glittering shards of ruby light.
panels.prose_en: The ancient spellbound glass dome violently implodes outward into glittering shards of ruby light.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin mantramugdh kaanch ka gumbad teji se bahar ki or ruby roshni ke chamakdar tukdon mein badal jata hai.

panels.action: The Ring of Hollow Blood levitates to eye-level, surrounded by swirling bands of crimson liquid mana.
panels.prose_en: The Ring of Hollow Blood levitates to eye-level, surrounded by swirling bands of crimson liquid mana.
panels.prose_hi: Khokhle khoon ka chhalla aankhon ke star tak udta hai, jo lal rang ke baingani mana roshni ki ghumti pattiyon se ghira hota hai.

panels.action: Drawn by an irresistible psychic pull, Ha-Jun slowly extends his right hand toward the levitating ring.
panels.prose_en: Drawn by an irresistible psychic pull, Ha-Jun slowly extends his right hand toward the levitating ring.
panels.prose_hi: Ek apratirodhya mansik khinchav se aakarshit hokar, Ha-Jun dhire-dhire apna dahina haath udti hui anguthi ki or badhata hai.

panels.action: The cold obsidian ring snaps onto Ha-Jun's right ring finger with a sharp metallic click, shrinking to fit snugly.
panels.prose_en: The cold obsidian ring snaps onto Ha-Jun's right ring finger with a sharp metallic click, shrinking to fit snugly.
panels.prose_hi: Thandi obsidian anguthi ek tej dhatvik click ke saath Ha-Jun ki dahini anamika par aa jaati hai, aur aaram se fit hone ke liye sikud jaati hai.

panels.shot: veins in arm turning bright crimson
panels.action: From his finger, a network of blazing scarlet veins spreads up his forearm, pulsing in sync with his heart.
panels.prose_en: From his finger, a network of blazing scarlet veins spreads up his forearm, pulsing in sync with his heart.
panels.prose_hi: Uski ungli se, dhadhakti lal rang ki nason ka ek network uske agrabhag tak fail jata hai, jo uske dil ke saath taalmel bithata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun arches his back, gasping as boiling liquid mana floods his arterial system with searing heat.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun arches his back, gasping as boiling liquid mana floods his arterial system with searing heat.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni peeth jhukata hai, hanfta hai kyonki ubalta hua baingani mana roshni uski dhamni pranali ko bheeshan garmi se bhar deta hai.

panels.action: Kuro screeches from an antique bookshelf: 'Control karo, Ha-Jun! Apne circulation ko lead karo!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dard ko reject mat karo! Use apna banalo!

panels.prose_en: Kuro screeches from an antique bookshelf: 'Control karo, Ha-Jun! Apne circulation ko lead karo!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ek prachin bukashelf se chillata hai: 'control karo, Ha-Jun! apne circulation ko lead karo!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun drops to one knee, smashing his left fist into the stone tiles to anchor his consciousness.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drops to one knee, smashing his left fist into the stone tiles to anchor his consciousness.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek ghutne par baith jata hai aur apni chetna ko sthir karne ke liye apni bayin mutthi ko patthar ki tailon par maarta hai.

panels.shot: eyes shifting from violet to dual crimson
panels.action: His pupils ignite into a double-ringed demonic eclipse: outer iris violet, inner core blazing ruby.
panels.prose_en: His pupils ignite into a double-ringed demonic eclipse: outer iris violet, inner core blazing ruby.
panels.prose_hi: Uski putliyan ek duble-ring wale shaitani demonic grahan mein prajvalit hoti han: bahari paritarika bangni, aantarik core dhadhakti rubi.

panels.action: Every drop of spilled blood across the cracked marble floor stops falling and begins floating upward in midair.
panels.prose_en: Every drop of spilled blood across the cracked marble floor stops falling and begins floating upward in midair.
panels.prose_hi: Tute hue sangmarmar ke farsh par bikhre khoon ki har boond girna band ho jaati hai aur hawa mein upar ki or tairne lagti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly rises to full height, exhaling a thin trail of crimson steam into the cold air.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slowly rises to full height, exhaling a thin trail of crimson steam into the cold air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dhire-dhire puri unchai tak uthta hai, thandi hawa mein lal rang ki bhaap ki ek patli kiran chhodta hai.

panels.action: A brilliant gold-and-crimson status notification unfolds in his peripheral vision.

dialogue.text:
[RELIC BONDED: RING OF HOLLOW BLOOD (BASIC)]
Synchronization: 28.5%
New Ability Unlocked: Blood Manipulation (Rank E)
Reduces blood loss by 80% during combat.

panels.prose_en: A brilliant gold-and-crimson status notification unfolds in his peripheral vision.
panels.prose_hi: Ek shandar sone aur lal rang ki sthiti adhisuchna uski paridhiy drishti mein prakat hoti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun rotates his hand; the ring pulses gently like an extra heartbeat directly tied to his pulse.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh ring... mere khoon ko mehsoos kar sakti hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rotates his hand; the ring pulses gently like an extra heartbeat directly tied to his pulse.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna haath ghumata hai; anguthi dheere se dhadakne lagti hai jaise ki ek atirikt dil ki dhadkan sidhe uski naadi se judi ho.

panels.action: From the broken iron hatch and dark archways, three feral low-level Demonic Ghouls crawl into view.
panels.prose_en: From the broken iron hatch and dark archways, three feral low-level Demonic Ghouls crawl into view.
panels.prose_hi: Tute hue lohe ke hatch aur andhere mehrabon se, teen junglee nimn-star ke shaitani demonic ghoul rengte hue dikhai dete han.

panels.action: Pale grey rotting skin, elongated razor claws, and hollow empty eye sockets leaking black tar-like fluid.
panels.prose_en: Pale grey rotting skin, elongated razor claws, and hollow empty eye sockets leaking black tar-like fluid.
panels.prose_hi: Pili dhusar sadti hui tvacha, lambe razr panje, aur khokhli khali aankh ki socket se kala tar jaisa taral padarth ris raha hai.

panels.action: Kuro sneers: 'Relic ki awakening ne in rotten scavengers ko attract kiya hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dekhte hain nayi ring kya kar sakti hai. Inhe apna dinner banao!

panels.prose_en: Kuro sneers: 'Relic ki awakening ne in rotten scavengers ko attract kiya hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro vyangya karte han: 'sade hue maila dhone walon mein avsheshon ki jagriti ne aakarshit kiya hai.'

panels.action: The largest ghoul leaps forward, jagged claws aimed straight at Ha-Jun's throat.
panels.prose_en: The largest ghoul leaps forward, jagged claws aimed straight at Ha-Jun's throat.
panels.prose_hi: Subse bada pishaach aage badhta hai, dantedar panje sidhe Ha-Jun ke gale par nishana sadhte han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands motionless, his gaze unblinking as the monster closes the distance.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands motionless, his gaze unblinking as the monster closes the distance.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun gatiheen khada hai, jaise hi rakshas doori ko band karta hai, uski aankhen bina palkein jhapkae rah jaati han.

panels.action: With a flick of his ring finger, the floating blood droplets stretch into razor-sharp crimson threads.
panels.prose_en: With a flick of his ring finger, the floating blood droplets stretch into razor-sharp crimson threads.
panels.prose_hi: Uski anamika ke ek jhatke se, tairti hui khoon ki bunden rager-nukile lal dhaagon mein fail jaati han.

panels.action: The crimson blood threads slice cleanly through the ghoul's hardened stone-like claws in midair.
panels.prose_en: The crimson blood threads slice cleanly through the ghoul's hardened stone-like claws in midair.
panels.prose_hi: Gahre laal khoon ke dhaage hawa mein pishaach ke kathor patthar jaise panjon ko saf-saf kaat dete han.

panels.action: The beast crashes onto the tiles, black blood spurting from its severed stumps as it howls.
panels.prose_en: The beast crashes onto the tiles, black blood spurting from its severed stumps as it howls.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar tailon se takrata hai, chillate samay uske kate hue thoonthon se kala khoon nikalne lagta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward, crimson mana swirling around his fingers: 'Ab meri baari.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chalo... dekhte hain mera khoon aur kya kar sakta hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward, crimson mana swirling around his fingers: 'Ab meri baari.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aage badhta hai, lal man uski ungaliyon ke charon or ghumta hai: 'ab meri bari.'
